name: capcut-automation

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && CAPCUT_AUTOMATION_STANDALONE_DIR=$PWD/.next/standalone npm run dev --prefix desktop/capcut-automation-desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build:stable --prefix desktop/capcut-automation-desktop && npm run prepare:expanded --prefix desktop/capcut-automation-desktop
scripts.desktop:dmg: npm run desktop:build && APPBUN_DMG_APP_PATH="$PWD/desktop/capcut-automation-desktop/build/expanded-macos-arm64/CapCut Automation.app" npm run build:dmg:expanded --prefix desktop/capcut-automation-desktop

description: Local video planning and CapCut draft generation for any channel
